resources.string: Observely
Observely message warnings
Observely reads notification text from a fixed set of SMS and chat apps to warn you about possible scams. It never stores, sends, blocks or deletes messages.
Get a warning when a text message looks like a scam. Observely only warns. It never blocks or deletes anything, and your texts never leave this phone.
Setup
Warnings are not fully on yet.
Warnings are on.
Finish each step marked off below. Observely will not claim alerts are on until every step is allowed.
Observely will only warn when the phone lets it post a notification.
1. Message notification access

Android calls this Notification access. It is broad, but Observely only processes notifications from a fixed set of apps: the built-in SMS apps, WhatsApp, Telegram, Messenger, Signal, Viber and LINE. Alerts only work when those notifications include the message text.
On — notification access is allowed.
Off — notification access is not allowed.
Open notification access
Turn on notification access
2. Warning-notification permission
Android 13 and newer ask for permission before an app can post notifications. On older versions this step is not needed.
Not needed — this Android version does not ask for this permission.
Allowed — Android permits Observely to post warning notifications.
Not allowed — Android blocks Observely from posting warning notifications.
Allow warning notifications
Open notification settings
3. Observely notifications
Android can still block all notifications from Observely, even when notification access is on.
On — Observely notifications are allowed.
Off — Android is blocking all Observely notifications.
4. Warning channel
Observely warns through one notification channel. It is created after notification access is turned on.
On — the warning channel is allowed.
Not set up yet — turn on notification access first.
Off — the warning channel is blocked.
Open warning channel settings
About this prototype

Observely is an offline prototype. Its warning classifier is bundled with a 0.51 cutoff and a two-warning-sign rule. It is not independently validated and it does not guarantee safety. It is not the evaluated M1 decision, which used a 0.630 cutoff.

Supported sources: built-in SMS apps (Google Messages, Samsung Messages and similar), WhatsApp, Telegram, Messenger, Signal, Viber and LINE. A warning only appears when one of those notifications exposes the message text.
Messages are checked on this phone and are never stored, logged, uploaded, blocked, or deleted.
Could not open these settings. Open Android Settings, then Notifications, then Device and app notifications manually.
